title: Field triggers
description: field/triggers.yaml of the game pack: what the player's cell does by its collision value (packages/game/field trigger_bands.hpp, docs/reference/campo.md). The engine also checks that the bands do not overlap, stay from 1 to 127 and give at most 10 exits.

step.description: Stepping on the cell runs the map script's section of that number, every frame on it.

confirm.description: Pressing confirm on the cell runs the section of that number.

exits.description: The cell takes the map's table warp of exit (value - first).

toilet.description: The partner that needs the toilet goes.

blocked_bit.description: A cell value with this bit blocks the way; the map format fixes it.
